apps.name: Madeira
apps.subtitle: Run Windows PC games on iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: Madeira runs Windows PC games on compatible iPhones using FEX-Emu, Wine, and a Metal graphics translation layer. This is an unofficial listing that follows the developer's GitHub releases.

versions.localizedDescription:
### New
- **In-app JIT: no StikDebug needed.** Madeira can enable JIT by itself through a bundled helper built on StikJIT. On iOS 27 it pairs with the iPhone it runs on: in Settings › Privacy & Security › Developer Mode, tap **Pair with Madeira** and enter the PIN Madeira shows. No computer needed. On iOS 26, import a pairing file instead. The pairing is kept in the Keychain. StikDebug still works. (#127)
- **Play turns JIT on for you.** If JIT is off, Play enables it and then starts the game. The button reads **Starting JIT** meanwhile.
- **Madeira JIT shortcut (iOS 27, optional).** LocalDevVPN's loopback does not work over cellular data. The shortcut connects LocalDevVPN, turns Cellular Data off when there is no Wi-Fi, and puts both back once the game has started, along with any VPN you were using. Add it during setup or in Settings › JIT.
- **Steam Cloud saves** for installed Steam games, on by default. Saves sync before and after you play, and the cloud copy is backed up before it is replaced. (#130)
- **A controller as keyboard and mouse**, chosen per game, with a Controller binds page. DirectInput is now a per-game choice too. (#128)
- **Setup** starts by installing LocalDevVPN when it is missing. It opens once more after this update, so you can pick one of the new JIT options.

### Fixed
- Games start faster: Wine starts as soon as the wineserver is ready, not after a fixed 2 s. (#125)
- Cuphead (#107), Nine Sols (#108) and Hades II (#119, #120) now run, and Steam app info with escaped quotes is read correctly (#118).
- JIT errors now explain the problem and offer a fix: **Pair Again** or **Connect LocalDevVPN**. The error also shows on the Settings tab.

### Known issues
- With Wi-Fi and Cellular Data both off, LocalDevVPN cannot connect, so JIT cannot be enabled, even with the shortcut. Connect LocalDevVPN while a network is available.

### Install
- Requires **iOS 26 or later**. In-app pairing and the Madeira JIT shortcut need iOS 27.
- If your sideloader asks whether to keep app extensions, keep them: Madeira's in-app JIT runs in one.
- The IPA is ad-hoc signed (no certificate) and carries the app's entitlements, including the increased memory limit. Sideload it with your own Apple ID (SideStore, AltStore, Sideloadly, Plume or similar), which signs it for your device.
- First-run setup walks you through JIT. Settings shows JIT and Memory+ with green checks and says **Ready to play**.

### Not included
The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs are not redistributed (see `legal/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`). Building from source: `tools/fetch-vcruntime.md`.

Thanks to Dan Perks ([@danperks](https://github.com/danperks)) for in-app JIT and pairing, Jesse ([@JesseLovelace](https://github.com/JesseLovelace)) for Steam Cloud saves, faster launches and the game fixes, and Nick ([@125hz](https://github.com/125hz)) for keyboard-and-mouse controllers.

apps.name: BCD Games
apps.subtitle: Play PC games on iOS — alpha builds
apps.localizedDescription: BCD is an experimental PC game compatibility app for iOS, in active alpha development. This is an unofficial listing that follows the developer's GitHub releases.

versions.localizedDescription:
**BCD is in alpha:** an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

## Fixes and improvements

> **Tried one of these games on an earlier build? Reset its settings first.** A game keeps the settings it had until you reset them, so without this it may start with the old ones that failed. On the game's page: **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended**, then check that **Options › Auto-tune › Auto-tune this game** is on, and start the game again.

These fix failures found in the logs you sent with Send Log and Report a problem, and in Discord reports, since 0.1.622. Each fix targets the error a log showed; most could not be tested on a device yet, so a game may now get further and still stop at a later point. If it does, please send a new log: it names the next problem.

- **Slay the Spire 2:** the crash about 9 seconds in (`System.AccessViolationException` in `Godot.Constructors`). When a write crossed the end of a 16 KB memory page, BCD's memory write emulation put the part past the boundary in the wrong place, which broke code the game's .NET runtime had just compiled. The game may now stop later (possibly at its Direct3D 12 swap chain); if it does, please send a log.
- **Kindergarten, Mycopunk, Skate Story and other Unity games that freeze at start:** BCD's x86 emulator kept a lock after a fault in one of its own helpers and then waited for itself, so the game hung. After such a freeze, Auto-tune now turns on the fix for the next start (`env.MADEIRA_MONO_BP_UNLOCKED_MISS = 1`, off by default).
- **Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number and Metro: Last Light without the Extended Virtual Addressing entitlement (seen on iOS 18):** the crash when the game could not load a DLL or reserve a large block of memory. On these devices' smaller address space, memory a game freed can leave system regions behind, and BCD kept trying to place new memory over them; it now looks past them. The same stop shows in logs of Terraria and Left 4 Dead. `env.MADEIRA_RESERVED_SKIP = 0` turns it off.
- **F1 2020:** runs (tried on an iPad Pro 13-inch with 0.1.622). Its recommended settings keep the switches of the runs that worked and now pause the game's GPU work while BCD is in the background (`env.MADEIRA_PAUSE_IN_BACKGROUND = 1`): iOS refuses a game's GPU work from the background, and the game hung when the player left BCD.
- **Bloons TD 6:** the game closed about 16 seconds in, when it loaded its Discord SDK plugin, which needs `qwave.dll`. BCD now ships Wine's `qwave.dll` for games that ask for it, and the game's new recommended settings turn it on (`env.MADEIRA_OPTIN_DLLS = qwave`). Not tried on a device yet.
- **Jackal:** the crash 8 seconds in, from its controller plugin, which looks for Windows' `wintypes.dll`. New recommended settings (Steam) give it Wine's (`env.MADEIRA_WINTYPES = 1`), as Risk of Rain 2 and Megabonk have. Not tried on a device yet.
- **Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter:** the recommended settings and Auto-tune now also reach the game when it is started from its program folder (`sora_1st.exe`), not only from BCD Dock.
- **The Forest:** on iPhones whose GPU cannot read BC-compressed textures, when iOS closes the game for using too much memory, Auto-tune now first tries `dxmt = d3d11.mipClampBC=1`, which skips the largest level of those textures and saves about three quarters of their memory.
- **Just Cause 2, Call of Duty: Black Ops and Saints Row (BCD Dock):** Steam's code 55 now comes with a plain explanation: it is a known stop, and no BCD setting is known to change it yet.
- **Auto-tune names more stops instead of retrying:** DOOM 3: BFG Edition, Half-Life and Counter-Strike, and An Arcade Full of Cats draw only with OpenGL, which BCD does not have yet; Digimon Story Time Stranger asks for 256 GB of address space in one piece, more than iOS leaves free in one piece; Forza Horizon 4 can wait in its own start-up code wi

**BCD is in alpha:** an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

## ✨ New

- **Marvel's Spider-Man 2 (experimental):** the game now gets from the launcher through the intro videos into the game, but it is experimental: the frame rate is still very low and it stutters. Fixed a memory deadlock when the game changes the protection of part of a JIT-backed region, the launcher's Setup window losing its owner, the V8 (Coherent UI) memory cage being decommitted under the game, character meshes breaking apart (typed buffers larger than 2^28 elements, which Metal cannot describe, are now read as raw buffers), slow occlusion-query fences (`fence-early = 2`) and blending on integer render targets. Its recommended settings also set an English locale (on a device set to another language the game stopped while loading), turn off x86 memory-order emulation and move runtime helpers to the efficiency cores, which reduced the stutter and the heat. Tried on an iPhone 17 Pro Max (12 GB).

## Other improvements

> **Tried one of these games on an earlier build? Reset its settings first.** A game keeps the settings it had until you reset them, so without this it may start with the old ones that failed. On the game's page: **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended**, then check that **Options › Auto-tune › Auto-tune this game** is on, and start the game again.

These fix failures found in the logs you sent with Send Log, in GitHub issues and in Discord reports since 0.1.614. Each fix targets the error a log showed; most could not be tested on a device yet, so a game may now get further and still stop at a later point. If it does, please send a new log: it names the next problem.

- **Heavy games start at 30 FPS, with a one-time tip:** Red Dead Redemption 2, GTA V (Enhanced and Legacy), Ghost of Tsushima, God of War, Horizon Zero Dawn and Forbidden West, Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart, the three Marvel's Spider-Man games and the Crysis Remastered trilogy now start with a 30 FPS limit (change it on the game's page), and before the first start BCD reminds you to set the game's own graphics to the lowest preset and AMD FSR, where the game has it, to Balanced or Performance. The limit is set when BCD first sees the game or when you press Reset to Recommended; a game you already set up keeps its own limit.
- **Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered:** no more stutter when you swing into a new part of the city; its recommended settings now compile new shader pipelines in the background (`pso-warm = 2`) instead of at their first frame.
- **Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales:** the recommended settings of Spider-Man Remastered (the same engine), for the Steam and DRM-free copies. Not tested on a device yet.
- **Swap file size (`swap-mb`):** with `swap-mode = 2`, `swap-mb` now limits how much of the swap file is on your device's storage: once the file reaches it, new game data stays in memory. Before, the limit was only checked when a memory region first went into the file, so the file could grow far past it (Marvel's Spider-Man 2 wrote 2.4 GB with `swap-mb = 256`). A game that reserves most of its memory early (Marvel's Spider-Man 2) can still go well past it, because what it already reserved in the file keeps going there; the limit applies to what comes after. If a game now closes with a small value, raise it. The Task Manager's **Swapped out** line shows the file's real size on storage. **Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart**'s recommended `swap-mb` is now 8192 so it keeps the room it used before.
- **Forza Horizon 4:** added the 64-bit `gamingtcui.dll` the game imports, and the `dxva2` its browser needs (recommended settings).
- **Tiny Tina's Wonderlands:** the pipeline-library exit is recognised, and the recommended settings turn on `d3d12-pipeline-library`.
- **Far Cry 3:** the updater's "Cannot find essential information in the registry" gets the ins

## ✨ New

- **Japanese, Chinese, Korean and standard Windows fonts:** BCD now links iOS system fonts into the Windows prefix for `MS Gothic`, `MS PGothic`, `MS UI Gothic`, `MS Mincho`, `Meiryo`, `Yu Gothic`, `SimSun`, `NSimSun`, `SimHei`, `Microsoft YaHei`, `PMingLiU`, `Microsoft JhengHei`, `Gulim`, `Batang`, `Malgun Gothic`, `Arial`, `Courier New`, `Times New Roman`, `Verdana`, `Georgia` and `Trebuchet MS` (including full-width Japanese font names), links CJK fallback glyphs into `Tahoma`, `Arial` and `System`, falls back to `CP1252` when a font's name table uses an unloaded Mac codepage, and keeps the `Marlett` symbol font from replacing normal window and dialogue text (**The Fruit of Grisaia**, **Touhou**).
- **Desktop Command Prompt and `.cmd` / `.bat` startup files:** opening **Command Prompt** from the Wine desktop Start Menu (or running `cmd /k`) now shows its console window while batch runs (`cmd /c`) stay hidden, and `.cmd` and `.bat` startup files are supported alongside `.exe` in Steam direct-start program pickers, **Add a game**, and **Also start this program** (#24).

## Other improvements

> **Tried one of these games on an earlier build? Reset its settings first.** A game keeps the settings it had until you reset them, so without this it may start with the old ones that failed. On the game's page: **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended**, then check that **Options › Auto-tune › Auto-tune this game** is on, and start the game again.

If it does, please send a new log: it names the next problem.

- **Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered:** rebuilt and packaged `d3d12.dll` (`madeira_d3d12.dll`) with `ID3D12GraphicsCommandList2::WriteBufferImmediate` (`write-buffer-immediate`) so the render thread no longer hangs on a black screen after pressing Play in the launcher, cleared any unsaved draft in the Game config editor when resetting to recommended settings or changing an option, and kept the mouse cursor visible above GDI launcher windows.
- **OMORI and Cuphead (installer):** fixed a freeze (`virtual_mutex` self-deadlock) when partially decommitting an uncommitted or read-only memory page (`decommit_pages`) or when an exiting thread's recycled `TEB` address matched `prev_teb` inside `virtual_free_teb`.
- **The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition and Fallout 4:** automatically enabled the 64-bit media decoder path (`MADEIRA_WG_64BIT = 1`) whenever `wmadmod.dll`, `wmvdecod.dll` or `mfasfsrcsnk.dll` is opted in, fixing missing music and dialogue audio, and broadened the media Auto-tune rule to trigger when `wmadmod.dll` is missing.
- **BeamNG.drive:** aligned 32 GB (`0x800000000`) soft-pool reservations to a 32 GB boundary (`0x7800000000`) for Chromium (`chrome_elf.dll`) PartitionAlloc and released uncommitted soft-pool reservations on `VirtualFree(..., MEM_RELEASE)` instead of returning `STATUS_MEMORY_NOT_ALLOCATED` (`0xc00000a0`) and hitting a `0x80000003` breakpoint.
- **007 First Light and Red Dead Redemption 2:** stopped large `PAGE_NOACCESS` step-down reservations (`>= 256 MB`) from steering into the FEX JIT arena once 24 GB is reserved, rate-limited repetitive `[jumbo]` and `[bigres-use]` log lines (preventing a 443 MB log spike), and broadened the Red Dead Redemption 2 28 GB reservation Auto-tune rule to match early exits and hangs.
- **Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR'S CUT and Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales:** converted `DELAYIMPORTS` to direct `IMPORTS` across all opt-in DLLs (`evr-optin.dll`, `d2d1-optin.dll`) so they never jump into x64 delay-load stubs from ARM64EC code, and automat

## ✨ New

- **Performance overlay, redone.** Choose Off, 1, 2, 3, 4 or Custom in the in-game menu (Display), on the game's page or in Settings › Graphics. Layout 1 is a single FPS figure; 4 is a full report with a frame-time graph, 1% lows, memory against the iOS limit, the JIT pool and thermal state. Custom lets you pick the readings, the place, the size and the opacity. It stays clear of the touch controls and sits in the black bars when the picture leaves room. Off by default.
- **Screenshots.** In-game menu › Tools › Take a screenshot keeps the game's own picture in Files and Photos. Send Log can include a small copy (about 100 KB).
- **When a session ends unexpectedly**, BCD asks once at the next start whether to send its log.
- **Input:** a key bar (Alt+Tab, Alt+Enter, Win, Esc, Del, F1-F12, Ctrl/Alt/Shift latches); gyro aiming; turbo buttons and macros; players 1-4 with per-player rumble; a radial menu, an aim zone and multi-finger gestures; touch-control colours and PlayStation symbols; Apple Pencil as a precise mouse; a controller-type choice (Xbox, DualSense, generic); a Paste key for iPad clipboard text; the mouse wheel scrolls.
- **In-game menu:** pause and resume, a list of open windows, a task page with memory and the JIT pool, a magnifier, sharp or smooth picture filtering, and log tools with ready-made debug settings.
- **Game page:** Windows version, built-in or the game's own DLLs, quick launch options, CPU translation presets, simple fixes (INI and registry values), Wine desktop size, theme and wallpaper, a start delay, a second program and window rules, save backups (by hand or when the game closes; restore asks first), and Help with this game: a guided run that ends in Send Log, and feedback on how a game ran.
- **MIDI music** now plays (older games were silent).
- **Windows desktop › Start menu:**
  - **BCD Tests:** system info, RAM 2-12 GB (it stops before iOS would close BCD), JIT pool, CPU, disk, network, DirectX 8/9/10/11/12, DirectDraw, frame time, display modes, sound, video, MIDI, controller and input tests, and "Run all tests".
  - **BCD Tools:** Task Manager, Command Prompt, Notepad, Registry Editor, Wine configuration, Control Panel, Uninstall a program, Game Controllers.
  - **BCD Runtimes:** XNA 4.0, PhysX, OpenAL and the DirectX June 2010 files, downloaded from their makers on request.
  - **7-Zip** (without RAR support).
- **Battle.net and the EA app** are back in the Launchers tab (experimental).

- **64-bit Direct3D 9:** a game that uses nothing newer now draws through DXMT by default (it failed before for lack of OpenGL). PICO PARK, Don't Starve Together and A Hat in Time have recommended settings for it.
- **Direct3D 8** games can draw through Direct3D 9. Grand Theft Auto III, Max Payne 2, POSTAL 2 and Hotline Miami get it in their recommended settings.
- **GTA V Legacy from the Epic Games Store** (and Rockstar's store) has recommended settings of its own.
- **The Adventures of Elliot:** recommended settings for its large program.
- **EA app (experimental):** fixed child browser-window layering so the sign-in and library view stays above the outer window

## ✨ New

- **Send Log asks what happened.** When you send a log (Settings › Send Log, a game's page, or after auto-tune), a box lets you add a few words: what the log cannot show, such as low FPS and where, a stutter, or what was on screen. Leave it empty to send the log alone. Please don't write personal details.
- **Games on an external SSD (experimental).** Settings › Storage › External SSD: pick a folder on a USB-C drive in the Files picker, and BCD shows it to Windows as `C:\External`, so you can add games that live there without copying them to the phone. **Reconnect** opens the saved folder again with one tap. Nothing changes until you pick a folder. On some iOS versions the folder picker may not answer; if that happens, please send a log. Thanks to Pardoxum (#12).

- **Minecraft Dungeons II:** recommended settings, and a fix for programs that open their files through `\\?\GLOBALROOT` paths. Thanks to le0-VV (#16).

## 🎮 New: Steam DLC

- **BCD now installs the DLC you own.** Before a game's first install, BCD asks Steam which DLC you own for it and lets you choose them, each with its size (**Choose your DLC**), or install the game alone. It asks every time you install.
- **Manage DLC after the install:** the game's page lists your DLC. Switch each one on or off and **Apply** downloads or removes it, or use **Install all your DLC**. DLC you do not own is listed under *Not in your library*.

## 🛒 New: Epic Games Store (early)

- **If the first sign-in stops at a step on Epic's side:** Epic sometimes needs you to accept an updated privacy policy or terms, or to answer an account question, before it lets an app sign in. BCD then says *"Epic wants you to finish a step on its website"*. Open epicgames.com in Safari (or any browser), sign in there and complete the step, then come back to BCD and sign in again.
- **Install and play:** BCD downloads and installs your Epic games and starts them signed in to your account (through a small helper, BCD Host), so a game that checks with Epic that you own it starts as it does on a PC. Starting such a game needs an internet connection.

- **Not yet:** game updates and repair, Epic cloud saves, and the Epic sign-in page some games show inside the game the first time.

apps.name: AirCard-iOS
apps.subtitle: Customize Apple Wallet cards, passcode themes and wallpapers
apps.localizedDescription: AirCard-iOS customizes Apple Wallet card artwork, passcode themes and PosterBoard wallpapers. Supports importing pairing files on iOS 18–26 and on-device pairing on iOS 27+. Follow the official project instructions to use LocalDevVPN and appropriate pairing.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed in v1.3.2 🚀

This update brings full feature parity with AirCard macOS v1.2.6, restores robust card discovery across all iOS versions, introduces automatic bank/network recognition with custom card nicknames, delivers an ultra-fast tunnel cache (0.02s connections), and completely resolves wallpaper flashing for Collections and Mercury wallpapers.

### 💳 Wallet Card Discovery & Bank Identification
• **Universal Wallet Log Parser**: Ported the proven `WalletScanParser` from AirCard macOS. Captures cards from `Dashboard loading (...): for SOO+`, `passIDs[InSession]`, `passIDs[global]`, and modern JSON NFC activations (`"identifier": "HEX"`).
• **Automatic Bank & Network Detection**: Recognizes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, Discover, and JCB via applet AIDs during selection.
• **Card Nicknames (Rename)**: Added a direct **Rename** button (✏️) so you can give your cards friendly names like *"Monobank"*, *"Salary Card"*, or *"Revolut"*, safely persisted in app settings.
• **28-Character Fallback Token Matcher**: Restores dependable card discovery on devices where standard log patterns are redacted.

### ⚡ Ultra-Fast Tunnel Routing (from 10s to 0.02s!)
• **Working Route Caching**: `rust-core` now caches the active RSD connection route (`LAST_WORKING_ROUTE`), eliminating repeated port and interface scanning.
• **RSD-First Priority**: Connects directly via RemoteXPC on port 49152, bypassing slow Lockdown retries and broken pipes on iOS 18+.
• **Eliminated Loopback Policy Drops**: Removed local loopback attempts that caused `policy drop` control channel errors.

### 🖼 Wallpapers (.tendies) — Collections & Mercury Fixes
• **Dual Injection on iOS 18+**: Wallpapers are now injected into both their primary bundle (`com.apple.WallpaperKit.CollectionsPoster` or `com.apple.MercuryPoster`) and the modern iOS 18+ application container (`com.apple.Posters.CollectionsPosterApp` / `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp`).
• **Metadata Synchronization**: Fixed a critical issue where `Wallpaper.plist`'s numeric identifier was randomized out-of-sync with `suggestionMetadata.plist` (`7400.DYNAMIC`), causing wallpapers like Windows 11 to vanish from the Lock Screen gallery.
• **Mercury Wallpaper Support**: Added recognition for `mercury-descriptors` container folders and registered `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp` in `PersistedPosterContainerBundleIdentifiers`.
• **NeoSpring Respring**: Instant springboard reload to apply wallpaper preferences immediately.

### 🧪 Quality & Testing
• All 24 unit tests passing (`TendiesEngineTests`, `WalletScanParserTests`, `CardPhotoCropTests`, `CardPhotoPickerTests`).
